text: Sit. The ball has gone QUIET for the first time in a long while.
Is that good?
It is RARE. A sky with nothing falling out of it.
You did that. Not the King. Not the fleet. YOU.
Go and be young somewhere. The eighth gate will keep.
The lost is found. I felt the room lighten when you walked in.
Then it is over?
No, child. That was the EASY thing.
PREPARE FOR GREAT TRIALS.
Iron is coming down out of the dark, and it does not care whose birthday it is.
Eat. Sharpen something. Stay near the KING.
Two sets of paws came through my door. Only one of you is lost now.
You can hear that?
I can hear a great deal. Take him to his FATHER. Straight there.
Do not stop to dig. Do not stop to gamble. The dunes will still be dunes tomorrow.
The cage is OPEN. I saw the bar swing.
Then why is he still down there?
Because nobody has ASKED him to come.
Go back down the stair. Say the words out loud. He will follow.
You have been drinking with talkers. Good. Now look.
What do you see?
STONE. Broken stone, west of the square, older than the King.
And a STAIR. Going down, where a stair has no business going.
He is under it. He is not alone under it. Take something that BITES.
Ah. You have been to the water already. The ball still tastes of it.
He was not there.
No. He RAN from there, with his heart up in his throat.
A frightened fox does not go home, child. He goes where the DRINK is.
Ask the regulars. All of them. One of them watched him leave.
You carry a name that is not yours. MAX. Everyone is saying it.
Do you know where he is?
I know where he WAS, and that is how you find anyone.
The ball is WET. Deep water, south of the square, and something old asleep under it.
Go to the LAKE. Find the one who was watching when it woke.
They say you can see what is coming.
I see what is already HERE. Most foxes simply have not looked yet.
Then what have I not looked at?
Something is LOST. Not a thing — a SOMEONE. And the whole town is about to notice at once.
You will be the one who finds him. That is not a kindness, it is just true.
Come back when you know his name, and I will tell you where to walk.
